pages.text: Loadout slots$(br2)A doll's loadout is a cross of four slots: a main hand, an off hand, a core and a cloth. Open it by right-clicking the doll item in your inventory, or right-clicking one of your dolls from the glove — from up to 16 blocks away. The cloth slot is not finished yet, so nothing goes in it.

Hand slots$(br2)Both hand slots take anything a doll can use — lance, danmaku, spell cards, potions, TNT and so on.$(br2)About consumables$(br2)Danmaku, throwable bottles and TNT are consumables, so they stack in the hand: N in the hand is N uses. Everything else is one item per hand, however big its own stack is.

About shields$(br2)A vanilla shield is not a weapon, but a doll holding one in its off hand blocks incoming projectiles and wears the shield down as it does; in the main hand it does nothing at all. When both hand slots hold the same item, the doll acts with whichever hand suits the order better.
Core slot$(br2)A folded talisman goes in the core, where it acts on the doll itself and nobody else — much like the player's charm slot.
